text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has ended. A subtle hint of 
autumn began to drift on the breeze...

We must return to the academy soon and 
begin preparations for the autumn races.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew, it was a drag at first, but... It 
turned out to be a nice, lazy summer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... I feel like all the 
junk that's been bottled up inside me 
since my debut just got completely washed 
away.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright Trainer, let's kick things into 
gear for our autumn goal.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, but... It's more about that 
than the race itself...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"She's" our target. That noisy girl. 
...She'll probably run in the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. At the end of spring—she did say 
that after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get stronger! Strong enough that 
you'll definitely want to run with me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just watch me this autumn. I won't let you 
get away this time. No, I won't even make 
you want to run away.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Since you talked such a big game, you'd 
better have a proper answer for me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What "number one" truly means to her. 
That's the answer I want.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's go find out for ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...No, that's part of it, but it's for my 
sake, too."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I was looking so cool taking on the Derby. 
Tripping up right after that wasn't very 
cool, though.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Starting this autumn, I'm resetting and 
going again! Striving to look even cooler 
than I did at the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I have a feeling she's the one who can 
teach me what that really is."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We're not the same as we were in the 
spring. Let's start over with a match 
against that guy.
